rust_summary: the render hook point `native_overlay_drawn(overlay)`: the final HUD and screen batch is drawn (`OverlayDrawn`).
doc_summary:
the render hook point `native_overlay_drawn(overlay)`, after HUD, screens, menus, toasts and tooltips, with the
actual target and GUI scale, before screenshot readback and HDR output conversion (`OverlayDrawn`). Bundles need `"hooks": @API:overlay_drawn@`.
